uutiset.t: Market Timers Get Schooled as S&P 500 Swings Rip Up Playbooks
uutiset.s: Avoiding down days in the stock market often means missing out on the biggest single-day gains. Those who cashed out after US equities reeled last week just learned that lesson the hard way.

uutiset.t: Turkey Frees Ex-Minister Arrested in Fund Scandal After 18 Days
uutiset.s: Turkey released former minister Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya from jail just 18 days after she was arrested in an investment-fund investigation that’s shaken the country’s markets.

uutiset.t: Behind Binance Hack, a Reckoning Over Who Controls Crypto
uutiset.s: As North Korean cyberthieves were funneling billions out of Binance last month, the world’s largest crypto exchange looked to two other companies to help stop the bleeding: Tether and Circle.

uutiset.t: The Oil Market Is Talking About a Surplus Again
uutiset.s: Resilient Persian Gulf exports, booming production elsewhere and shrinking demand are all tilting the balance back toward an oversupply.

uutiset.t: Fund With $21 Billion Favors Africa Local Bonds, Adds to Uganda Bet
uutiset.s: A currency rout that wiped 8% off the value of Uganda’s shilling last month rattled some investors, but failed to deter a $21 billion money manager.

uutiset.t: AI Returns Matter More Than Nvidia Drama, Says Goldman’s Bell
uutiset.s: Nvidia Corp.’s boardroom drama doesn’t alter the outlook for the artificial intelligence trade, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s Sharon Bell, who says the ability of companies to generate sufficient returns on massive investments remains key.

uutiset.t: Ousted BP Chairman Manifold to Join Aggreko Board Amid US IPO
uutiset.s: Former BP Plc Chairman Albert Manifold, who was ousted earlier this year, will join the board of power equipment and services firm Aggreko Plc as part of its move to float in the US.

uutiset.t: Stock Rally Takes Breather as Nvidia Euphoria Wears Off
uutiset.s: The rally in stocks that followed Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia is giving way to caution as traders wait for further evidence that the artificial intelligence trade can build on its rebound. uutiset.t: Arabica Drops as Exchange Stockpiles Surge Most in 28 Years
uutiset.s: Arabica futures fell as supplies in exchange-monitored warehouses posted their biggest daily jump since 1998, with Brazilian supply flowing into a market that had faced historic tightness.

uutiset.t: Huang’s Return Hits the Reset Button for AI Bets
uutiset.s: Jensen Huang is back at the center of the AI trade.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Breaks Below $83 IPO Price in Premarket Trading
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares briefly fell below their $83 initial public offering price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut.

uutiset.t: Mercuria Hires Alex Humphries as Global Head of Fuel Oil Trading Ahead of Eni JV
uutiset.s: Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. hired Alex Humphries from BP Plc as head of fuel oil trading, adding to the list of senior appointments ahead of the firm’s trading venture with Eni SpA.

uutiset.t: Xi Plays Long Game on US Chip Retaliation After Nvidia Whiplash
uutiset.s: After a week of whiplash over Jensen Huang’s future and new US chip curbs, Beijing sent a clear message to Washington about their trade truce: China is holding up its side of the bargain — for now.

uutiset.t: JPMorgan, HSBC Trade New London Digital Gold for First Time
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and other major precious metals dealers traded a new form of digital gold in London for the first time, an early test of a system that could revamp the plumbing of the world’s biggest bullion hub.
